quotes.text: There was a priesthood conferred upon the sons of Levi throughout the generations of the Jews. They were born heirs to that priesthood by lineage or descent and held the keys of the first principles of the gospel.
quotes.speaker: Joseph Smith
quotes.attr: Joseph Smith, Discourse of 21 March 1841, recorded by William P. Mc Intire; WJS, 67
